rows.en:
Oh, Michel.
Wanna have lunch together, if you're free?

Yeah, sure.
Then let's grab something and eat it
up on the roof......
rows.notes: Interrupted mid-verb (Klan calls out next); kept trailing.

rows.en: Hm? Hey, Klan. What's up?
I-I made a bento today, but...

By mistake...
Yes, by mistake, I made two of them, so
if you want, I suppose I could spare you one!
(...Klan-senpai is so easy to read.)

...Geez.
Making two by mistake? You're such a klutz.

Can't be helped.
It'd be a waste to let it go uneaten,
so I'll eat it for you.
So yeah, sorry, \p...
Sure. Go enjoy lunch with Klan-senpai.

Sorry about this, \p.
Now then, let's go eat right away, Michel.

(Say what they will, those two
really do get along...)

Oh, Michel-kun.
Wanna have lunch together, if you're free?
(...Klan-senpai is so easy to read.)

(Phew... a shower after EX-Gear training
feels so good...)

Yo, \p.
Today's class was rougher than usual, huh?

You call that rough?
You really do live up to the name 'Princess,'
don't you, Princess Alto?
rows.notes: Quoted hime rendered 'Princess' in single quotes, title 'Princess Alto' as in earlier slices.

rows.en: Hey, you picking a fight... Michael?

Me, pick a fight? Perish the thought.
I was just worried about Her Highness's
health, that's all.
Michael!

Geez, Alto, Michel, cut it out.
Don't start fighting in the shower room.
You're bugging everyone.
Aw, man. Guess I made him mad.

Michel, you tease Alto way too much.
You know that's just how Alto is...
It's just my own way of showing affection, though.

...So you're the type who picks on
the one you like?
Heh, maybe so.

(I think that kind of affection
backfires with Alto, though...)

(Phew... today's EX-Gear training
was a tough one.)

Saotome-kun, Michel-kun, cut it out.
Don't start fighting in such a cramped place.
You're bugging everyone.

Michel-kun, you tease Saotome-kun way too much.
You know that's just how Saotome-kun is...

...You mean you're the type who picks on
the one you like?

(I think that kind of affection
backfires with Saotome-kun, though...)
(Now, what should I buy today...)

(Hm? Is that Michel and Yamashiro-sensei?
That's an unusual pair...)

What are you doing here,
Michel, Yamashiro-sensei?

Hm? If it isn't \p.
I was about to buy some new glasses
when I happened to run into Michel.

We were just having a passionate discussion
about glasses.

(A passionate discussion about glasses...
What kind of conversation is that......?)

I've always wanted to talk glasses theory
with Yamashiro-sensei sometime. It was by
chance, but I'm really glad we got to talk today.

Black horn-rims really do suit
Yamashiro-sensei perfectly.
rows.notes: Michel praises Yamashiro in the third person, in front of him; kept third person.

rows.en: Heh, flattery won't get you anything...
But your glasses aren't bad either.

Oh, looks like I'm intruding,
so I'll be going now...

(Do people who wear glasses share
some kind of Way of the Glasses...?)
(Now, what should I buy today...)

(Hm? Is that Michel-kun and Yamashiro-sensei?
That's an unusual pair...)

What are you doing here,
Michel-kun, Yamashiro-sensei?

(A passionate discussion about glasses...
What kind of conversation is that......?)

Oh, looks like I'm intruding,
so I'll be going now...

(Do people who wear glasses share
some kind of Way of the Glasses...?)
(Summer break's started, but I'm so bored...)

Hey, Shirakawa.
Heading out somewhere?
Yes, to our villa on the artificial island.
rows.notes: Possessive 'our' restored for the villa (the player answers that it is hers).

rows.en:
A villa?!
Just what you'd expect from a rich girl.
You're on a whole other level...

W-well, I say villa, but it's really
nothing all that special...
It's a really small place...
Just having a villa at all is plenty amazing.

...W-well then, I'll be going.
I'll bring you a souvenir, so look forward to it.
Yeah, see ya~

(...Guess I'll grab some ice cream
on the way home.)
(Summer break's started, but I'm so bored...)

Hiya, Miyuki!
Heading out somewhere?

A villa?!
Just what you'd expect from a rich girl.
You're on a whole other level...
Just having a villa at all is plenty amazing~

(...Guess I'll grab some ice cream
on the way home.)

uncertain: c18260: interrupted line kept trailing at 'up on the roof......' (Japanese breaks off mid-verb).
c18298: Michel praises Yamashiro in the third person while facing him; kept.
c18311: 'our villa' restores the possessive (Japanese has only 'the villa on the artificial island').
c18275: 'Princess' in single quotes for the quoted hime.
